panels.title: Last successful check
panels.description: Checks older than the stream's freshness TTL turn the 45-day window UNKNOWN.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(checked_at) AS "last ok" FROM solution_check_run WHERE stream = '${stream}' AND outcome = 'ok'

panels.title: Latest check outcome
panels.description: A failed or source-unavailable check makes every in-window cell unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT outcome FROM solution_check_run WHERE stream = '${stream}' ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Problem days
panels.description: Overdue, invalid, unknown and awaiting-recheck cells in the time range (pending before the deadline is normal and not counted).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state NOT IN ('available', 'not_expected') AND reason <> 'before_deadline') AS n FROM solution_day_grid('${stream}',
        ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        now()) WHERE station IN (${station:sqlstring})

panels.title: Overdue: confirmed absent
panels.description: Only these are confirmed missing. A day's run counts as done when half the expected stations have that day; a station still missing it after the deadline is absent. 'late' means the run for that day is not done.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM solution_day_grid('${stream}',
        ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        now()) WHERE station IN (${station:sqlstring}) AND state = 'overdue' AND reason IN ('absent_after_completion', 'producer_rejected', 'producer_failed')

panels.title: Unexpected files
panels.description: Files the check did not read: legacy aliases, .gz, our stations missing from the roster. Files of stations that are not local (abroad, or inactive) are not counted; 'Stations: all' lists them below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(unexpected_files) u WHERE u ->> 'reason' NOT IN ('not_local', 'not_in_fleet')) AS n FROM solution_check_run WHERE stream = '${stream}' AND outcome = 'ok' ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

options.content:
**Legend**   ✓ available / verified   ❄ available / frozen   … pending / before deadline   ↻ pending / awaiting recheck   late overdue / no completion record   ✗ overdue / absent after completion   rej overdue / producer   inv invalid   – not expected   ? unknown
States come from `solution_day_grid` only (plan §3). Click a station for its data-delivery and receiver dashboards.

panels.title: Stations with missing solutions
panels.description: One row per station. Status = the latest day that is due (pending before the deadline is not due). Since / Days = the current gap; Total = all problem days in the range: the due days after the last available day ('≤' = the gap starts before the time range). Missing = confirmed (the producer finished without it); Late = not yet confirmed. Click the station for its grid and other dashboards.

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (SELECT * FROM solution_day_grid('${stream}',
        ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        now()) WHERE station IN (${station:sqlstring})),
due AS (SELECT * FROM g WHERE state <> 'not_expected' AND reason <> 'before_deadline'),
cur AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (station) station, state AS cur_state, reason AS cur_reason
        FROM due ORDER BY station, day DESC),
agg AS (SELECT station,
               max(day) FILTER (WHERE state = 'available') AS last_ok,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE state <> 'available') AS problem_days
        FROM due GROUP BY station),
gap AS (SELECT d.station, min(d.day) AS since, count(*) AS gap_days
        FROM due d JOIN agg a USING (station)
        WHERE d.day > coalesce(a.last_ok, '-infinity'::date)
        GROUP BY d.station),
areas AS (SELECT sam.sid,
                 -- one short label: the volcano area first, then the region;
                 -- "+N" says how many more (the Area filter covers them all)
                 (array_agg(sa.area_name ORDER BY (sa.area_type = 'volcanic') DESC,
                            sa.area_name))[1]
                 || CASE WHEN count(*) > 1 THEN ' +' || (count(*) - 1)::text ELSE '' END
                   AS area_list
          FROM station_area_members sam JOIN station_areas sa USING (area_id)
          GROUP BY sam.sid),
st AS (
  SELECT c.station, s.station_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, ar.area_list, x.agency,
         s.sid AS plot_sid,  -- yang plots only our own stations
         CASE WHEN c.cur_state = 'overdue' AND c.cur_reason IN
                   ('absent_after_completion', 'producer_rejected', 'producer_failed') THEN 4
              WHEN c.cur_state IN ('overdue', 'pending') THEN 3
              WHEN c.cur_state = 'invalid' THEN 2
              WHEN c.cur_state = 'unknown' THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END AS status,
         CASE WHEN c.cur_state = 'available' THEN NULL
              WHEN a.last_ok IS NULL THEN '≤ ' || gp.since::text
              ELSE gp.since::text END AS since,
         CASE WHEN c.cur_state = 'available' THEN 0 ELSE gp.gap_days END AS gap_days,
         gp.since AS since_date, a.last_ok, a.problem_days,
         CASE WHEN c.cur_state = 'available' THEN NULL ELSE c.cur_reason END AS reason
  FROM cur c JOIN agg a USING (station)
  LEFT JOIN gap gp USING (station)
  LEFT JOIN stations s ON s.sid = c.station
  LEFT JOIN areas ar ON ar.sid = c.station
  LEFT JOIN solution_station x ON x.station = c.station)
SELECT station AS "SID", station_name AS "Name", area_list AS "Area",
       agency AS "Agency",
       status AS "Status", since AS "Since", gap_days AS "Days",
       last_ok::text AS "Last good", reason AS "Reason",
       plot_sid AS "Plot", problem_days AS "Total"
FROM st
WHERE '${show}' = 'all' OR problem_days > 0 OR status > 0
ORDER BY status DESC, since_date NULLS LAST, station

properties.value: Volcano area first, then region; +N = more areas
station_owner in stations.cfg (as the health board's Station Owner)
Length of the current, still open gap
All problem days in the time range, including gaps that have recovered

panels.title: Map: current status
panels.description: Each station coloured by the status of its latest due day (same as the list). Stations without coordinates in `stations` are not shown.

SELECT latitude, longitude, status, station AS "SID", station_name AS "Name",
       since AS "Since", gap_days AS "Days", reason AS "Reason"
FROM st WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY status

SELECT station, day::text AS day, state, reason, fact, code AS fact_code, last_verified_at
FROM solution_day_grid('${stream}',
        ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        now())
WHERE station IN (${station:sqlstring}) AND state NOT IN ('available', 'not_expected') AND reason <> 'before_deadline'
ORDER BY CASE state WHEN 'overdue' THEN 1 WHEN 'invalid' THEN 2 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, day DESC, station

SELECT state, reason, count(*) AS days FROM solution_day_grid('${stream}',
        ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        now())
WHERE station IN (${station:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT checked_at, outcome, error, cell_count,
       left(roster_version, 12) AS roster_version,
       window_from::text AS window_from, window_to::text AS window_to
FROM solution_check_run WHERE stream = '${stream}'
ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Unexpected files and other products (latest ok check)

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (SELECT unexpected_files, other_products FROM solution_check_run
           WHERE stream = '${stream}' AND outcome = 'ok'
           ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT u ->> 'name' AS file, u ->> 'reason' AS reason
FROM r, jsonb_array_elements(r.unexpected_files) u
WHERE u ->> 'reason' NOT IN ('not_local', 'not_in_fleet') OR '${scope}' = 'all'
UNION ALL
SELECT o.key || ' (' || o.value || ' files)', 'other product (not checked)'
FROM r, jsonb_each_text(r.other_products) o
ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Station × UTC day
panels.description: One cell per station and UTC day. Frozen = valid when last verified, now older than the 45-day re-check window. 'late' = no completion record; '✗' = absent after the producer finished (confirmed).

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (SELECT * FROM solution_day_grid('${stream}',
        ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
        now()) WHERE station IN (${station:sqlstring}))
SELECT station, to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day,
       CASE
      WHEN state = 'available' AND reason = 'verified' THEN 1
      WHEN state = 'available' THEN 2
      WHEN state = 'pending' AND reason = 'before_deadline' THEN 3
      WHEN state = 'pending' THEN 4
      WHEN state = 'overdue' AND reason = 'no_completion_record' THEN 5
      WHEN state = 'overdue' AND reason = 'absent_after_completion' THEN 6
      WHEN state = 'overdue' THEN 7
      WHEN state = 'invalid' THEN 8
      WHEN state = 'not_expected' THEN 9
      ELSE 10
    END AS code
FROM g
WHERE '${show}' = 'all' OR station IN (SELECT station FROM g WHERE state NOT IN ('available', 'not_expected') AND reason <> 'before_deadline')
ORDER BY day, station
